reviews.text: The most attentive and helpful vets you could wish for. They've been caring for my little one since he was born, and I couldn't have hoped for anything better. They're also always available by email, which is incredibly rare.

Dr. Moretti and Dr. Meni are competent, capable, and honest professionals. They vaccinated my dog ​​with great care and attention; he didn't even cry; he was more relaxed than I was!

They are very thorough throughout the procedure, explaining every step well.

I also greatly appreciate their honesty in not recommending unnecessary vaccines or treatments. They asked about the dog's lifestyle and adapted their recommendations accordingly.

They put the animal's well-being first, not profit!

A rare blend of expertise and integrity.
Congratulations and thank you!

Almost lost our cat’s eye to this vet as he mistook herpes virus for a basic allergy.

we did a treatment upon his suggestion but we noticed the eye wasn’t getting better.

So we went to another clinic and the vet managed to :

1 - confirm the eye had herpes virus and needed IMMEDIATE treatment within the first check up

2 - sought out and organise an eye specialist to to make sure there wasn’t anything else wrong.

3 - gave us the correct treatment to lessen the impact on our cats eye.

Sadly our cat still has a virus in his eye. Thankfully not as bad as it was in the beginning.

For serious / complex medial issues ( for cats ) , I strongly suggest seeking a second opinion else where.
Excellent clinic, I am very happy with the staff, they are very competent and the place is always very clean, compliments
I would like to thank Dr. Polli and Dr. Moretti for their support and for caring for my beloved dog for over 14 years.
I went there a month ago for a checkup on my kitten. Both vets were kind, welcoming, and professional. My kitten felt at ease.
Outpatient clinic for general visits, vaccinations, and minor procedures.

After 13 years of going to this clinic (and having a great experience), I changed vets a month ago.
My dog ​​is like a son to me, and when I see a professional whose ego is more important than his skills, I unfortunately argue. I'm talking about a doctor whose name I don't remember (and I don't even care) because I'd never seen him there.
(I've always interacted with Moretti.)
PS. I'm still waiting for the dog's ultrasound (never had it in my hands), but according to you, it didn't show any liver spots... Too bad that in another office, they did an ultrasound (in my presence) three days later and found his liver covered in spots (which was OBVIOUS given the blood tests).

Kindness and helpfulness are guaranteed at this veterinary clinic, which I trusted for the first time (reading the reviews), but the veterinary expertise I expected (reading the reviews) was very basic, just sufficient. This is why I turned to another, more competent veterinary clinic. I took a recently adopted stray cat to the vet, and at the first visit (after basic ear, fur, fecal examination, heart and lung checks, and fever checks), I was scheduled for a 15-day vaccination appointment and a week after the first vaccination for another vaccine (called a booster). The cost of the two vaccine injections was €110, which was very expensive, whereas at the other veterinary clinic I went to, a single injection of the trivalent vaccine cost €50. The price difference is significant, and I don't consider Spontini to be honest.
Furthermore, and this is the most important thing they told me in the other veterinary clinic I went to: when a cat is a newly adopted street stray (and the cat's past is unknown), it must be isolated in quarantine for 40 days. It is useless to vaccinate it before 40 days because if it has any ongoing diseases, the immune defenses in these 40 days are busy fighting the disease or the virus or bacteria and therefore it is useless to vaccinate it before 40 days (because it would have no effect). It should be noted that the veterinarian Spontini wanted to vaccinate the newly adopted street stray cat after 15 days.
Professionals
Professionalism, courtesy, and expertise. Valentina is fantastic and incredibly kind. The practice is very clean and tidy. I will definitely be back if I need it again.
Excellent and honest. I always go there with my cats and dog, and they've always examined and cared for them with great care.

They've been caring for our furry friends for years.
Truly kind, helpful, and professional.

If you're looking for competent, empathetic, and honest veterinarians, this is the clinic for you. They offer the utmost availability, professionalism, and compassion. And the free cookie distribution doesn't hurt!
Qualified, very kind staff.

Super friendly and professional!
My dog and I enjoyed our visit, thanks Dr. Valentina 😊 …

The owner is reassured by the environment and the courtesy but often notices important signs and is willing to spend for an additional examination and perhaps save his dog. My dog ​​died a week after a reassuring visit.
Very good and competent!
Dr. Valentina and the entire clinic team are extremely helpful. They took excellent care of my little Ottone during his first few months together. Recommended.

I've always been happy with the service, in fact I've been going to this clinic for 20 years, both Dr. Polli and Dr. Moretti are very good, they have patience and respect for their patients, I'm happy with it.
Always available on the phone and very kind doctors
Well done! Nothing else to add. Thanks for everything.
